infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Amora uses your location to detect when you're near your linked partner so it can switch to your shared couple wallpaper automatically. Location is shared only with your linked partner.

plugins.photosPermission: Amora needs access to your photos so you can pick a picture for your wallpaper.
Amora needs access to your photos to save wallpapers you create.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Amora needs to save wallpapers to your photo library.

plugins.userTrackingUsageDescription: Amora shows a rewarded ad here so you can earn free AI wallpaper credits. This identifier helps show ads that are more relevant to you.
